field_dictionary.purpose: column roles, name synonyms and missing markers for the mini batch in records.json

rule_catalog.precedence: Lower priority number wins; a case-supplied rule replaces a builtin rule with the same id.

tolerance.note: replicates within 5% of the group mean are kept individually and flagged, never averaged

rules.name: id_present
rules.condition: the row carries a non-blank identifier
rules.failure_mode: rows cannot be cited back to the source

rules.name: id_missing_or_duplicate
rules.condition: no identifier column, a blank identifier, or two rows sharing one identifier
rules.transform: derive an id, or append a #k suffix
rules.failure_mode: two physical rows collapse into one

rules.name: unparsed_value
rules.condition: the cell is text or a mixed expression

rules.name: range_value
rules.condition: the cell is a to b range
rules.transform: keep low/high, leave the point value empty
rules.failure_mode: a range midpoint is presented as measured

rules.name: missing_value
rules.condition: empty cell or a missing marker
rules.failure_mode: a missing measurement is written as 0

rules.name: error_term
rules.condition: the cell carries a plus/minus error
rules.failure_mode: the error is folded into the value

rules.name: unit_conversion
rules.condition: source and target share a dimension
rules.transform: after = before * factor + offset; scale the error only
rules.failure_mode: an offset is applied to the error

rules.name: unknown_or_ambiguous_unit
rules.condition: the unit is unknown, or dimensionless and polysemous (%, ppm, rpm)

rules.name: missing_unit
rules.condition: a numeric value carries no unit
rules.failure_mode: the value is treated as dimensionless

rules.name: synonym_exact
rules.failure_mode: near matches are merged by fuzzy distance

rules.name: duplicate
rules.condition: same judgment key and identical value
rules.transform: merge, keep the first, link duplicate_of

rules.name: replicate
rules.condition: same judgment key, spread within the tolerance

rules.name: conflict
rules.condition: same judgment key, spread beyond the tolerance
rules.failure_mode: a disagreement is resolved by picking the larger value

rules.name: dimension_mismatch
rules.condition: source and target differ in dimension
rules.transform: queue; a molar mass is required
rules.failure_mode: mass is converted to moles without one

rules.name: empty_input_degrade
rules.transform: status insufficient_evidence, keep the contract keys
rules.failure_mode: an empty run looks like a success

rules.name: no_change
rules.failure_mode: an empty change log is read as a silent edit

unit_table.note: value_in_base = value * scale + offset; only same-dimension conversions are performed
